meta.name: ai-marketing-videos
meta.description: Create AI marketing videos for ads, promos, product launches, and brand content. Models: Veo, Seedance, Wan, FLUX for visuals, Kokoro for voiceover. Types: product demos, testimonials, explainers, social ads, brand videos. Use for: Facebook ads, YouTube ads, product launches, brand awareness. Triggers: marketing video, ad video, promo video, commercial, brand video, product video, explainer video, ad creative, video ad, facebook ad video, youtube ad, instagram ad, tiktok ad, promotional video, launch video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成营销视频，用于广告、促销和品牌内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作营销视频用于广告或社交媒体
copy.tagline_en: Create AI marketing videos for ads, promos, and brand content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce marketing videos for ads or social media

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成营销视频，支持产品演示、品牌故事、广告等类型，可指定 Veo、Seedance 等模型生成画面，并用 Kokoro 添加配音。
howto.when: 当用户提出制作营销视频、广告视频、产品推广视频等需求时触发，例如提到“营销视频”、“广告视频”、“产品视频”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我生成一个30秒的产品广告视频。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Veo 等模型生成视频片段并合成。

say.text: 制作一个15秒的 Instagram 竖版广告。
say.note: Claude 会按平台格式生成适配视频。

say.text: 为这个 SaaS 产品写一个60秒的讲解视频脚本。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Claude Sonnet 生成脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate marketing videos via command line, supporting product demos, brand stories, ads, etc. It uses models like Veo, Seedance for visuals and Kokoro for voiceover.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests creating marketing videos, ad videos, product promos, etc., such as mentioning 'marketing video', 'ad video', 'product video'.

say_en.note: Claude will call Veo etc. to generate and assemble clips.
Claude will produce a video in the correct format.

say_en.text: Write a 60-second explainer video script for this SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will use Claude Sonnet to generate the script.
